title: Bayesian Hiring Agent
outcome: Cost-aware, fairer resume screening by orchestrating multiple LLMs under uncertainty.
context: Written up as a sole-authored preprint — "Bayesian Orchestration of Multi-LLM Agents for Cost-Aware Sequential Decision-Making", arXiv 2601.01522.
problem: Screening at volume forces a choice nobody wants to make explicit: give every candidate the same expensive model pass, or give them all the same cheap one. The first does not scale and the second is where unfair outcomes hide.
approach: Treat model choice as a sequential decision under uncertainty rather than a fixed pipeline: orchestrate several LLMs and spend more capable, more costly evaluation only where the decision is genuinely uncertain.
